promotion: Zero candidate execution errors, unplanned crop losses, escapes, missed feeding, duplicate targets, or seed overrequests.
Zero final shed/carried inventory and unused seeds.
Positive paired match-score difference with whole-seed bootstrap 95% interval above zero.
Investigate any opponent-class score regression over five percentage points; do not promote unexplained regression.
Exact standalone file passes isolated self-play and action timeout.
Source frozen before these seeds. Retire all seeds if a strategy change is needed.
protocol.scope: Two independently coded expanding mixed/dairy variants, frozen Step 7, historical melon/strawberry specialists, and independent delayed crop supply. No recreation of private leaderboard code.

promotion_gates.runtime_interpretation: Two parallel games exceeded nominal actTimeout without exhausting the engine overage budget. All six games above 0.5 seconds were checked serially with unchanged artifact; their banks matched. Original timings are retained. This is not a server hardware guarantee.

paired.interpretation: Paired common-pool comparison. The percentile interval resamples whole seeds, preserving seats and opponents. It describes this small internal pool, not leaderboard strength; unseen opponent classes and model-selection bias remain outside the interval.
